info.name: FTS SQL
info.summary: Full text search over the database Nextcloud already runs
info.description:
A full text search platform for the fulltextsearch framework that indexes into the database the Nextcloud instance already runs — PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB or SQLite — so nobody has to operate Elasticsearch to get full text search.
Plain text, the OOXML and ODF office formats (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx, .odt, .ods, .odp), PDF and the legacy binary Office formats (.doc, .xls, .ppt) are indexed by their body text, extracted in pure PHP — no external service, no external binary. Extraction runs over streams under a memory budget, and a document that cannot be read whole is still indexed on what was recovered, with the reason counted on the admin card.
info.author: Néfix Estrada
